S-METAPROGRAMMING.Purpose: Build-time code production pipeline: generate reactive implementations for Widget and ordinary FVP declarations, then weave compiled auto-properties onto those implementations.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Roslyn source generation for Widget and ordinary FVP partial classes — owned by SS-SOURCE-GENERATORS.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Generated counterpart contract shared by source generation and IL weaving.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Post-compile IL redirection of annotated auto-properties via Fody/Mono.Cecil.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Runtime behavior of generated code — owned by S-RUNTIME-PLATFORM and S-WIDGETS.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Game engine APIs: pipeline targets netstandard2.0 and never references Unity types.

Principles.PRIN-001: Source generation and IL weaving communicate through generated counterpart symbols.
Principles.PRIN-002: Invalid declarations produce source-generation diagnostics; missing generated counterparts produce explicit weaving errors.
Principles.PRIN-003: Generated symbols are the only coupling to the runtime: e.g. Widget._Update{Prop}FromAncestor (see M-INHERITED-CONTEXT).

Requirements.REQ-001: Supported Widget and ordinary FVP declarations receive reactive implementations compatible with property weaving.
Requirements.REQ-003: The weaver redirects every annotated auto-property getter/setter to its generated counterpart (M-PROPERTY-WEAVER.REQ-001).
